payload.title: A 25 percent robust U projection is tail-safe across frozen bases
payload.statement: Retaining 75% of each raw prediction and applying 25% robust U=TVT+Z projection will improve all registered base, spatial-cell, repeated-fold, tail, and private-sized bootstrap evaluations without introducing a public-specific inference dependency.
payload.evidence_for: All seven bases passed; 105/105 registered spatial cells and 175/175 repeated fold cells improved. The T055 full-pool base improved from 8.702719707562 to 8.546005491968, and the frozen cap remained within bounds.
payload.evidence_against: T055 itself transferred poorly to the public leaderboard, and neither T063 nor T064 has a public score yet. Local all-cell success is not hidden-score evidence.
payload.next_test: Measure the exact frozen action only through notebook-linked submissions T063 and T064; do not alter strength or add another scoring layer.
